map.根据实际温度和湿度，修正标准发酵时间（基准温度27°C）: Adjust the standard fermentation time based on actual temperature and humidity (reference temperature 27°C)
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(0.7,min(1.3,humFactor): Core formula (by input variables): max(0.7, min(1.3, humFactor)); (q10)^(temp - refTemp / 10); 1 + humDiff × 0.008
map.室温偏低，稍延长: Slightly low room temperature, slightly extended
map.💡 发酵速度随温度变化遵循 Q10 系数（约2-3），即温度每升高10°C，发酵: 💡 Fermentation speed changes with temperature following the Q10 coefficient (about 2-3): for every 10°C rise, fermentation speed roughly doubles to triples. The reference temperature is set to 27°C.
map.室温偏离面包标准发酵温度（约 26°C）时，修正一次发酵所需时间。: When room temperature deviates from the standard bread fermentation temperature (about 26°C), adjust the time needed for the first fermentation.
map.冬季室温低、夏季室温高，按温度差调整发酵时长。: In winter the room is cold, in summer it is warm; adjust fermentation duration by the temperature difference.
map.冷藏（低温）长时间发酵，估算过夜发酵的总时长。: Estimate the total duration of overnight refrigeration (low-temperature) fermentation.
map.20°C 室温相对 26°C 标准的修正: Correction for 20°C room temperature vs the 26°C standard
map.按 Q10 规则，温度每降 10°C 发酵速率约减半（Q10≈2）。标准 26°: By the Q10 rule, every 10°C drop roughly halves the fermentation rate (Q10≈2). Standard 26°C needs 60min; at 20°C: t = 60 × 2^((26-20)/10) = 60 × 2^0.6 ≈ 60 × 1.52 ≈ 91min, i.e. extend to about 91 minutes.
map.Q10 是什么，烘焙里怎么用？: What is Q10 and how is it used in baking?
map.Q10 表示温度每升高 10°C 生理/化学反应速率的倍数，酵母发酵一般取 2–: Q10 is the factor by which a physiological/chemical reaction rate increases per 10°C rise; yeast fermentation generally uses 2-3. Use t₂ = t₁ × Q10^((T₁-T₂)/10) to estimate fermentation time at different temperatures.
map.冷藏发酵时间怎么算？: How to calculate cold-retard fermentation time?
map.4°C 左右酵母活性极低，一次发酵常需 8–12 小时甚至过夜，风味更好。可用同: At around 4°C yeast activity is very low; first fermentation often takes 8-12 hours or overnight, with better flavor. The same Q10 formula can extend the low-temperature duration, but at low temperature it is only approximate; judge by dough state (risen about 1x, finger poke does not spring back).
